people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”
translations.bsb: The high places of Aven will be destroyed— it is the sin of Israel; thorns and thistles will overgrow their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, “Cover us!” and to the hills, “Fall on us!”
